Subject: Morning interview — locked out of building, can we shift to phone?

I can wait, but I don't want to keep the interviewers waiting if their schedules are tight. Would it be possible to do a phone interview at the same time or reschedule? I'm happy to do a phone-first 30-minute interview and then come back for a short in-person follow-up later if needed.

Phone: (415) 555-9182

Sorry for the last-minute trouble — please let me know what works.

Thanks,
Gabriel Rios
Candidate — Software Engineer

- Move forward with the 9:30 slot as a 30-min phone screen + 30-min take-home/code prompt afterward (we can convert the second half to a take-home task today).
- Pause and reschedule for later today once he's on-site.

If everyone agrees to phone-first, Gabriel has provided this number: (415) 555-9182. I attached the interview runbook and the candidate task in case we pivot to a take-home.

Gabriel — please expect a calendar update if we switch formats. Also I've included building security in case you need any additional coordination (they can buzz you in when locksmith arrives).

–Olga
